annotations.title: Order an Audit Drive or a drive

description: Step 3 of 3: orders for your product (prices before tax; every detail and limit: https://agentdrives.com/pricing.json). Every driven product is listed free. free, the Free check ($0): what an agent sees, private; no domain proof; one per domain every 90 days. audit, an Audit Drive ($499): a new drive (our agent signs up like a new customer; no access needed), every documented API route, MCP tool and CLI command checked against your docs, a security review (always included), your fix list and a new drive after your fixes for 120 days (followup_drive); when the drives find an agent uses the product fully with no person (L5) it ends in a certificate. target (1 to 5): your goal, never a promise. renewal, the Audit Drive renewal ($199 a year), from 11 months after your audit. Report within 48 hours. Also stack3 or stack, a Stack check ($490, $1,490), and a data plan, builder ($49 a month: any number of follows, a webhook) or team ($290 a month: that and the bulk export of every listing, GET /api/export). Your own product's drive detail: GET /api/detail/<slug> or MCP drive_detail, in full with the Audit Drive. A paid order for your own product needs a verified claim on its domain (403 claim_not_verified says how) and business: true (we sell to businesses). With online payment on, payment.url comes back: the page that takes the payment (the same order again while it waits: that order, reused); an Audit Drive and its renewal, a Stack check and a data plan also return payment.agent, to pay over HTTP 402 without a person (pay_order). Paid over HTTP 402, a data plan runs one month and doesn't renew by itself: pay again before it ends and the next month follows on. We email you 3 days before it ends. Ordering accepts the terms (https://agentdrives.com/legal/terms). An error comes with its fix.

access.description: Not on an Audit Drive or its renewal (400 access_not_needed: we sign up ourselves; give a discount code with pay if your plans are paid). A Stack check or an old order only

authorise.description: With pay kind code, required: true is your go-ahead, "Our agent may buy and cancel my paid plan with this code." (else 400 authorise_required)

business.description: Paid orders: true confirms you buy for your business. AgentDrives sells to businesses only (https://agentdrives.com/legal/terms#business); the order records it. Stripe's checkout asks the business name, billing address and VAT ID for the invoice

buyer.description: An Audit paid over HTTP 402 (pay_order): optional, for our invoice. The price includes any VAT; an EU VAT ID that VIES confirms gets our invoice at once, with no VAT outside the Netherlands.

address.description: Postal address for the invoice, one line

country.description: Two-letter code of your business's country, e.g. US

vat_id.description: EU VAT ID with its country prefix, e.g. DE123456789

code.description: Optional: a promotion code of ours. Its discount comes off this order, at the card checkout and over HTTP 402 (400 invalid_code when it is unknown, expired or used up)

email.description: An agent's own account, a Stack check or a data plan: the address for the receipt and our mails about the order (the comparison ready, the plan's end). Optional

idempotency_key.description: Optional: any unique value, e.g. a UUID. Sending the order again with the same one returns the order it made, never a second one (24 hours); the same one with other fields is refused (idempotency_key_reused)

listed.description: false: the drive stays private, never in the directory

no_offers.description: Paid orders: true and we send you no offers for our other products

note.description: Optional: anything our agent should know

offers_ok.description: free: true only if you want the monthly agent access report and offers

pay.description: Optional on an Audit Drive, required on a Payment proof (proof): let our agent buy your plan at your own checkout. kind code: your discount code (value) that leaves $0.50 a purchase (on an Audit Drive it works for every drive until 120 days after the report, its purchase inside the price; on a Payment proof our card pays it at cost); send authorise: true with it; sandbox: a login to your checkout's test mode or sandbox (value), for the free checkout test only (an Audit Drive answers 400 access_not_needed: we sign up ourselves); seat: no value, we email you the address our agent signed up with, you upgrade it. Sealed, never shown back.

value.description: code: 6 to 64 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores; sandbox: the login (up to 2,000 characters)

plan.description: The Audit only: your paid plan. The drive buys it, uses one paid feature, cancels it and asks for the refund your product's own way. choice include: at cost as its own line on this order, the unused part refunded after the drive; self_refund: you refund the drive's purchase, at most $50 a month (above it: plan_needs_person, choose include or write to us); none. name and price_cents (a month, US cents; whoami's claims[].plan_hint suggests one). Above $50 a month add confirm: true; above $500 by arrangement

processor.description: With pay kind code: your checkout. card: Stripe, Lemon Squeezy, Shopify or another checkout, your code leaves $0.50 and a Payment proof costs $0.87; paddle: Paddle, your code leaves $0.70 and a Payment proof costs $1.09. Default card

product.description: free: Free check · audit: Audit Drive · renewal: Audit Drive renewal · proof: Payment proof · stack/stack3: Stack check · builder/team: data plans. The Monthly drive (monthly, yearly, verified_month, verified) is retired: 400 product_retired. Orders answer with the ids above; whoami's orders keep the stored ones (drive an Audit Drive, a renewal with renewal_of; quick and report: retired Findings and Full report orders)

target.description: audit or renewal: the level you aim for. It is your goal, shown on your dashboard, never a promise: the level is the one the drives find

tool.description: Your product's directory slug, if listed

urls.description: Stack check: the tools to drive

use_case.description: Stack check: what your agents should do with them
